Core Banking Customer 360 - Feature Specification: Aadhaar & Credit Scoring Integration

1. Overview

As part of our Core Banking Customer 360 initiative, we need to extend our customer onboarding and credit risk assessment models to capture mandatory Indian regulatory identifiers and automated credit health metrics.

2. Business Requirements

UI Component (Frontend)

  • Add a new input field for Aadhaar Number in the customer KYC registration form.

  • The field must enforce a strict validation rule: exactly 12 numeric digits (^\\d{12}$).

  • Include a real-time validation error message if the format is invalid.

  • Add a read-only display element for Calculated Credit Score retrieved from the bureau.

ETL Pipeline (Data Engineering)

  • Update the data ingestion script (customer_onboarding_etl.py) to parse and sanitize the incoming aadhaar_no field.

  • Mask the middle 8 digits of the Aadhaar number when logging or outputting to non-secure streams (e.g., store as XXXX-XXXX-1234).

  • Compute a preliminary risk index based on the customer's monthly income and credit history.

MDM & Schema Governance (Database)

  • Alter the customer_master relational table to include the new columns:

    • aadhaar_no VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL UNIQUE

    • credit_score INT CHECK (credit_score BETWEEN 300 AND 900)

  • Update data governance DDL scripts and ensure migration validation rules pass before deployment.
jira_ui_task:
Title: [UI] Implement Aadhaar Input Validation and Credit Score Display

User Story:
As a Bank Officer, I need an interface to enter the customer's 12-digit Aadhaar number with real-time validation and view their calculated credit score so that onboarding complies with Indian regulatory standards.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Add a input text field for 'Aadhaar Number' in the KYC registration form.
2. Implement front-end regex validation matching exact 12 numeric digits (^\d{12}$).
3. Display an inline real-time error message when the input format is invalid.
4. Add a read-only field/display component for showing the 'Calculated Credit Score' returned from the credit bureau endpoint.
jira_etl_task:
Title: [ETL] Update Customer Ingestion Pipeline for Aadhaar Masking and Risk Index Calculation

User Story:
As a Data Engineer, I need to update customer_onboarding_etl.py to process Aadhaar details securely and compute a risk index during ingestion.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Modify customer_onboarding_etl.py to parse and sanitize the incoming aadhaar_no field.
2. Mask the middle 8 digits for non-secure outputs and logging streams (e.g., format as XXXX-XXXX-1234).
3. Compute a preliminary risk index utilizing monthly income and credit history attributes.
4. Ensure transformation logic runs error-free within the ETL workflow.
jira_mdm_task:
Title: [MDM/DB] Schema Update for Customer Master Table - Aadhaar & Credit Score Columns

User Story:
As a Database Administrator, I need to modify the customer_master schema and DDL scripts to store validated Aadhaar and Credit Score fields.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Execute DDL migration to add 'aadhaar_no' VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL UNIQUE to customer_master.
2. Add 'credit_score' INT with a CHECK constraint (credit_score BETWEEN 300 AND 900).
3. Update data governance scripts and ensure migration validation tests pass prior to deployment.
mdm_ddl:
-- MDM Customer Master Schema Definition
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.customer_master (
    id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, -- MDM unique record identifier
    full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, -- Cleansed customer full name
    pan_number VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- Permanent Account Number unique identifier
    aadhaar_no VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- 12-digit Aadhaar number as specified in Jira task
    masked_aadhaar VARCHAR(14), -- Masked Aadhaar representation for privacy display
    monthly_income DOUBLE PRECISION, -- Monthly income numeric value
    credit_score INT CHECK (credit_score BETWEEN 300 AND 900), -- Bureau credit score with range constraint
    risk_index DOUBLE PRECISION, -- Calculated financial risk index metric
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, -- Standard audit column for record creation
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL -- Standard audit column for last update
);

-- Performance Indexes for Master Data Queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customer_master_pan ON public.customer_master(pan_number);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customer_master_aadhaar ON public.customer_master(aadhaar_no);

-- UPSERT Example using PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT Logic
INSERT INTO public.customer_master (
    full_name, pan_number, aadhaar_no, masked_aadhaar, monthly_income, credit_score, risk_index
) VALUES (
    'Ananya Sharma', 'ABCDE1234F', '999988881098', 'XXXX-XXXX-1098', 85000.0, 765, 22.5
)
ON CONFLICT (pan_number) DO UPDATE SET
    full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
    aadhaar_no = EXCLUDED.aadhaar_no,
    masked_aadhaar = EXCLUDED.masked_aadhaar,
    monthly_income = EXCLUDED.monthly_income,
    credit_score = EXCLUDED.credit_score,
    risk_index = EXCLUDED.risk_index,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
